svg.text: Bend 12 bar round a 100 mm former into a full ring,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 112 mean diameter; saw across it to make two halves

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: with a 2 mm gap at each joint.

svg.text: Ears: four 6 x 25 x 42 flat bar, 8.5 hole 18 out from

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the bar centre; weld one to each end, holes in line.

svg.text: Tang: 6 x 28 x 84 flat bar, welded on the outside of the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: fixed half midway between the joints, 4 below its top.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Tang holes 10.5, 6.5 and 2.1 at 20, 46 and 70 up,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 14 from the inner edge. Galvanise after welding.
